name: Add search bar to top bar
description:
# Summary of Conversation

1. **Added TopBarSearch Component** - Created a new search bar in the top navigation that searches across multiple project elements (files, profiles, users, chats) with intelligent filtering.

2. **Reused ChatIntelliSense** - Leveraged the existing ChatIntelliSense component to display search results with consistent UI, avoiding duplicate code and maintaining feature parity.

3. **Keyboard Shortcuts & Navigation** - Implemented Ctrl+K to focus the search bar, Tab/Enter to select results, Arrow keys to navigate, and Escape to dismiss suggestions.

4. **Selection Behavior** - Regular clicks open results in appropriate viewers (files in file viewer, profiles/users in dedicated views), while multi-select with checkboxes adds items to the active chat.

5. **Positioned Below Search Bar** - Positioned ChatIntelliSense suggestions panel directly below the search input with proper z-index and spacing, integrated with search progress tracking and cancellation support.
